services.name: Eco-Explorer Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Note: Dinner Paused through Rainy Season Approx. 2+ Hours What to Expect Tour begins with a relaxing cruise into the Tampa Bay Estuary to see the diverse wildlife dependent on the area. You'll also learn a bit about our local history. Soon the sun will sink over the horizon of the Gulf of Mexico, and you will be treated to an unforgettable painted sky. You may even see dolphins frolicking alongside the boat. This tour includes an optional catered meal and a soft drink or water. Please note: 6 passengers minimum per tour (not per party) Tour departures 2 Hours • All Ages • Most Popular Tour!

services.name: Sweetheart Dinner Cruise
services.desc: You and your sweetheart will enjoy a romantic one-of-a-kind dolphin eco-tour that concludes with a breathtaking sunset over Tampa Bay. In addition, you and your date will receive a catered meal with a choice of specialty dining options and wine or champagne. A special dessert will follow dinner as we cruise the estuary and Tampa Bay to find perfect sunset views and Adults Only • Romance on the River!

blurb: Authentic 5-star Rated Local Experience: Discover the beauty of Tampa Bay with Latitudes Tours in Ruskin, Florida. We offer daily narrated eco-tours, sunset dinner cruises, and guided kayak tours through the scenic Tampa Bay Estuary and Little Manatee River. Spot dolphins, manatees, and native birds while learning about the area’s rich ecosystem.
